metadata.title: Trusted Application

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for operating applications as trustworthy, accountable, and policy-governed institutional systems.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Application services, APIs, web applications, background workers, and decision-making systems implementing institutional logic.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern asserting that all trust requirements for an application have been satisfied.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Trusted applications assume baseline ownership, purpose, and lifecycle governance.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Trusted applications require correct enforcement of identity and authorization decisions.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Trusted applications require safe and unambiguous interpretation of inputs and requests.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Trusted applications require correct preservation of identity, privilege, and execution context across interactions.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Trusted applications require responsible, purpose-limited use and exposure of data.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Trusted applications require bounded execution context and limited blast radius.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Trusted applications require visibility, explainability, and governance oversight.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Privilege escalation through flaws in application logic or authorization.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Defense evasion via abuse of application behavior and error handling.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Persistence through unmanaged or legacy applications.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong identity binding and authorization enforcement.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging and observability to support accountability and investigation.

metadata.remarks: Trusted Application is a composite pattern asserting that an application can be relied upon as a secure, accountable, and governable system. It introduces no independent controls and exists solely as an aggregate trust claim for solution patterns, system security and privacy plans, and architectural risk analysis.

components.title: Application Core
components.description: Baseline trust assumptions for applications as institutional systems.

components.title: Application Identity and Authorization
components.description: Correct enforcement of identity and authorization decisions within the application.

components.title: Application Input and Request Handling
components.description: Safe, explicit, and unambiguous interpretation of requests and inputs.

components.title: Application Session and State Management
components.description: Correct preservation of identity, privilege, and execution context over time.

components.title: Application Data Handling
components.description: Purpose-limited and policy-aligned use of data by applications.

components.title: Application Runtime and Execution Boundaries
components.description: Bounded execution context and controlled blast radius.

components.title: Application Observability and Governance
components.description: Visibility, explainability, and governance oversight of application behavior.
